states.name: Rajasthan
states.tagline: The Land of Maharajas, Golden Sands, and Majestic Forts
states.description: Rajasthan is India's jewel of royal extravagance. Here, colossal hill forts watch over bustling bazaars resplendent with bandhani textiles, camel caravans traverse undulating dunes of the Thar, and fairytale palaces rise out of shimmered lakes in Udaipur.
culturalHighlights: Folk dances like Ghoomar and Kalbelia fire-spinning
Block-printing textiles from Sanganer and Bagru
Regal Rajputana miniature paintings and Blue Pottery
Vibrant annual fairs including Pushkar Camel Fair

famousCuisine.name: Dal Baati Churma
famousCuisine.desc: Crispy baked wheat dumplings steeped in desi ghee, paired with spicy lentils and sweet crushed jaggery wheat.

famousCuisine.name: Laal Maas
famousCuisine.desc: Fiery royal mutton curry prepared in whole Mathania red chilies and yogurt.

famousCuisine.name: Ghevar & Pyaaz Kachori
famousCuisine.desc: Honeycomb disc pastry dipped in saffron sugar syrup alongside flaky onion pastries.

attractions.name: Amber Fort
attractions.desc: Opulent yellow-sandstone fortress with Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace) overlooking Maota Lake.

attractions.name: Mehrangarh Fort
attractions.desc: Perched 400 feet above the Blue City, offering breathtaking ramparts and royal palanquins.

attractions.name: Lake Pichola & City Palace
attractions.desc: Marble wonder rising out of tranquil waters with views of the floating Jag Mandir.

attractions.name: Sam Sand Dunes
attractions.desc: Sunset camel safaris, desert folk camps, and stargazing under crisp desert skies.

states.travelTips: Dress modestly at temples and forts. Keep hydration handy in the daytime. Pre-book royal palace museum entry tickets to skip queues.

states.name: Kerala
states.tagline: God's Own Country of Serene Backwaters and Emerald Hills
states.description: Kerala is a tropical paradise fringed with coconut palms, tranquil lagoons, emerald tea terraces of Munnar, and centuries-old Ayurvedic heritage. Gliding on a traditional kettuvallam houseboat through Alleppey is an unforgettable experience.
culturalHighlights: Classical dance-drama Kathakali with vivid face paints
Ancient martial art form Kalaripayattu
Thrissur Pooram and majestic Vallam Kali snake boat races
Spiritual ritual performance of Theyyam in Malabar

famousCuisine.name: Appam with Vegetable Ishtu
famousCuisine.desc: Lacy fermented rice batter pancakes paired with coconut milk simmered stew.

famousCuisine.name: Kerala Sadya
famousCuisine.desc: Grand 24-course vegetarian banquet served traditionally on a fresh plantain leaf.

famousCuisine.name: Malabar Fish Curry
famousCuisine.desc: Tangy, spicy mackerel or kingfish infused with kokum and fresh ground coconut paste.

attractions.name: Alleppey Backwaters
attractions.desc: Drift along sleepy canal villages, paddy fields, and lagoons on thatched luxury houseboats.

attractions.name: Munnar Tea Plantations
attractions.desc: Rolling emerald hills carpets, tea tasting museums, and sightings of endangered Nilgiri Tahr.

attractions.name: Fort Kochi
attractions.desc: Iconic cantilevered Chinese fishing nets, Portuguese synagogues, spice markets, and art cafes.

attractions.name: Varkala Cliff Beach
attractions.desc: Dramatic coastal cliffs overlooking the Arabian Sea, yoga shalas, and natural spring waters.

states.travelTips: Book overnight houseboat stays well in advance during Dec-Jan. Respect eco-tourism guidelines in Wayanad and Periyar reserves.

states.name: Himachal Pradesh
states.tagline: Devbhoomi — The Abode of Gods, Cedar Forests & Snow Peaks
states.bestMonths: March to June & Oct to Feb
states.description: Nestled in the Western Himalayas, Himachal Pradesh boasts pine-scented valleys, turbulent glacial rivers, high-altitude passes, and Tibetan monasteries in Dharamshala. From adventurous backpacking in Parvati Valley to tranquil apple orchards in Kinnaur, it captivates every traveler.
culturalHighlights: Kullu Dussehra festival bringing hundreds of local village deities together
Tibetan Buddhist prayer wheels and butter sculptures in McLeod Ganj
Kath-Kuni architectural style made with interlocking cedar and stone
Chamba Rumal and intricate handwoven Kullu shawls

famousCuisine.name: Himachali Dham
famousCuisine.desc: Traditional celebratory meal prepared by Botis, featuring Madra (chickpeas in curd), Mah ki Dal, and Khatta.

famousCuisine.name: Siddu
famousCuisine.desc: Steamed wheat bread stuffed with spiced crushed walnuts, poppy seeds, and dipped in warm ghee.

famousCuisine.name: Tudkiya Bhath
famousCuisine.desc: Piquant Himachali one-pot pulao cooked with lentils, potatoes, cardamom, and curd.

attractions.name: Spiti Valley
attractions.desc: 1000-year-old Key Monastery, Chandratal lake, and high-altitude hamlets untouched by time.

attractions.name: Solang Valley & Rohtang
attractions.desc: Paragliding, skiing, zorbing, and breathtaking views of Pir Panjal mountain ranges.

attractions.name: Tsuglagkhang Complex
attractions.desc: Serene spiritual complex with monastery, Namgyal stupa, and Tibetan institute of performing arts.

attractions.name: Jibhi & Tirthan Valley
attractions.desc: Crystalline trout streams, cedar treehouses, and gateway to Great Himalayan National Park.

states.travelTips: Carry motion sickness meds for winding mountain passes. Layer clothing even in summer as evenings turn chilly rapidly.

states.name: Goa
states.tagline: Sun-Kissed Beaches, Portuguese Baroque Cathedrals & Susegad Spirit
states.description: India's smallest state packs world-renowned charm. From the vibrant beach clubs of North Goa to the serene, pastel-colored Latin Quarter of Fontainhas and tranquil palm shores of South Goa, its blend of Indo-Portuguese culture and relaxed 'Susegad' lifestyle is incomparable.
culturalHighlights: Goa Carnival with flamboyant street floats and mask dances
UNESCO-inscribed Baroque churches in Old Goa
Mandovi river sunset cruises with live brass bands and Konkani folk music
Cashew feni distillation traditions and spice plantation walks

famousCuisine.name: Goan Prawn Curry with Poee
famousCuisine.desc: Succulent prawns simmered in fiery coconut and red tamarind gravy served with fresh local crusty bread.

famousCuisine.name: Pork or Chicken Vindaloo
famousCuisine.desc: Portuguese-influenced dish steeped in vinegar, garlic, and Kashmiri red chilies.

famousCuisine.name: Bebinca
famousCuisine.desc: Rich traditional multi-layered Indo-Portuguese pudding made from coconut milk, egg yolks, and nutmeg.

attractions.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
attractions.desc: 16th-century baroque architecture enshrining the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier.

attractions.name: Palolem Beach
attractions.desc: Calm azure waters ideal for kayaking with dolphins, silent noise parties, and relaxed beach shacks.

attractions.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter
attractions.desc: Narrow winding cobblestone alleys lined with vibrant yellow, blue, and terracotta Portuguese villas.

attractions.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls
attractions.desc: Four-tiered roaring 310m cascade nestled in Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary, crossed by railway viaduct.

states.travelTips: Renting a scooter/bike requires a valid driving license and mandatory helmet. Respect local beach swim flags indicating red safe zones.

states.name: Ladakh
states.tagline: The Land of High Passes, Blue Lakes & Starlit Celestial Skies
states.description: Ladakh is a lunar wonderland set between the Karakoram and Great Himalayas. Known for ancient cliffside Gompas, the magnetic blues of Pangong Tso, two-humped Bactrian camels in Nubra Valley, and Khardung La — one of the highest motorable roads on Earth.
culturalHighlights: Hemis Tsechu festival featuring colorful Cham mask dances
Centuries-old Thangka silk scroll paintings and brass mandalas
Unique Ladakhi Goncha woolen robes and turquoise stone jewelry
Stargazing sanctuaries and Hanle Dark Sky Reserve

famousCuisine.name: Thukpa & Tingmo
famousCuisine.desc: Steaming hot Tibetan noodle soup with local vegetables and herbs served with pillowy steamed bread.

famousCuisine.name: Chhurpi & Butter Tea (Gur Gur Chai)
famousCuisine.desc: Yak cheese delicacy accompanied by salted churned tea made with yak butter and tea leaves.

famousCuisine.name: Skyu
famousCuisine.desc: Traditional Ladakhi comfort stew made with hand-kneaded thumb dough pasta and root vegetables.

attractions.name: Pangong Tso Lake
attractions.desc: Saline lake that magically shifts shades from deep turquoise to cobalt blue against bare brown peaks.

attractions.name: Nubra Valley & Hunder Sand Dunes
attractions.desc: White dunes with double-humped Bactrian camels and the giant 32-meter Maitreya Buddha statue.

attractions.name: Thiksey Monastery
attractions.desc: Twelve-story Tibetan Buddhist complex perched commandingly over the Indus Valley.

attractions.name: Khardung La Pass
attractions.desc: Legendary mountain pass at 17,982 ft connecting the Indus Valley to the Shyok and Nubra valleys.

states.travelTips: Acclimatize in Leh for at least 48 hours before heading higher. Inner Line Permits (ILP) are mandatory for Pangong, Nubra, and Hanle.

states.name: Uttar Pradesh
states.tagline: The Heartland of Sacred Rivers, Mughal Grandeur & Living History
states.description: Uttar Pradesh is the spiritual beating heart of India. From the timeless Ganges ghats of Varanasi where evening Aarti lights up the sky, to the world wonder Taj Mahal in Agra and the Awadhi culinary legacy of Lucknow, its history runs deep.
culturalHighlights: Varanasi Ganga Aarti with grand multi-tiered brass oil lamps
Awadhi Chikankari delicate hand-embroidery from Lucknow
Classical Kathak dance originating from ancient temples
Kumbh Mela, the largest spiritual gathering on Earth

famousCuisine.name: Galouti Kebab & Sheermal
famousCuisine.desc: Melt-in-the-mouth Awadhi minced patties infused with over 100 secret spices, eaten with saffron flatbread.

famousCuisine.name: Banarasi Kachori Jalebi & Paan
famousCuisine.desc: Urad dal kachori with spiced hing aloo curry followed by crispy sweet jalebis and meetha paan.

famousCuisine.name: Agra Petha
famousCuisine.desc: Translucent candied ash gourd sweet flavoured with saffron, rose, or kewra.

attractions.name: Taj Mahal
attractions.desc: Ivory-white marble mausoleum on the south bank of the Yamuna, a sublime testament to eternal love.

attractions.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
attractions.desc: Experience dawn boat rides witnessing spiritual life and the captivating evening Maha Aarti.

attractions.name: Bara Imambara
attractions.desc: Vast vaulted hall built without iron or wood beams, housing the famous Bhool Bhulaiya labyrinth.

attractions.name: Fatehpur Sikri
attractions.desc: Emperor Akbar's abandoned 16th-century imperial capital featuring the towering Buland Darwaza.

states.travelTips: Taj Mahal remains closed on Fridays. In Varanasi, early sunrise boat rides (5:30 AM) offer the most serene perspective of the ghats.

states.name: Meghalaya
states.tagline: The Abode of Clouds, Living Root Bridges & Crystalline Rivers
states.description: Perched in the lush northeastern hills, Meghalaya is famous for bio-engineered living root bridges crafted by the Khasi tribe, Cherrapunji's roaring waterfalls, the glass-like waters of the Umngot River in Dawki, and Asia's cleanest village Mawlynnong.
culturalHighlights: Matrilineal lineage traditions of the Khasi, Garo, and Jaintia tribes
Indigenous bio-engineering of Ficus elastica living root bridges
Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival and vibrant indie rock music culture
Bamboo and cane basketry and handwoven Ryndia silk

famousCuisine.name: Jadoh with Dohkhleh
famousCuisine.desc: Fragrant short-grain rice cooked in rich meat stock served with refreshing pork and onion salad.

famousCuisine.name: Tungrymbai
famousCuisine.desc: Fermented soybean paste sautéed with pork, black sesame seeds, and local ginger.

famousCuisine.name: Pukhlein
famousCuisine.desc: Crispy deep-fried sweet Khasi rice flour treats sweetened with jaggery.

attractions.name: Double Decker Living Root Bridge
attractions.desc: Trek down 3,500 stone stairs through rainforest to witness two-tier living root bridges spanning river rapids.

attractions.name: Dawki & Umngot River
attractions.desc: Emerald river water so crystalline that wooden canoes appear to float suspended in air.

attractions.name: Nohkalikai Falls
attractions.desc: Stunning 340-meter single drop waterfall plunging into an electric green pool amid misty cliffs.

attractions.name: Mawlynnong Village
attractions.desc: Renowned as Asia's cleanest village, featuring immaculate floral lanes and treehouse lookouts.

states.travelTips: Carry sturdy waterproof trekking shoes for Nongriat root bridges. Rain gear is essential throughout the year.

states.name: Tamil Nadu
states.tagline: Dravidian Temple Towers, Carnatic Rhythms & French Boulevards
states.description: Tamil Nadu is the heartland of Dravidian art and temple architecture, home to towering sculpted Gopurams, ancient bronze casting, classical Bharatanatyam dance, Nilgiri hill railways, and the tranquil seaside promenades of coastal heritage.
culturalHighlights: Classical Bharatanatyam dance traditions and December Carnatic Music Season
Brihadeeswara Temple and Great Living Chola Temples
Chettinad mansion architecture and Tanjore gold foil paintings
Kanchipuram pure mulberry silk sarees handwoven with zari borders

famousCuisine.name: Chettinad Chicken Pepper Curry
famousCuisine.desc: Deeply aromatic gravy flavored with star anise, stone flower (kalpasi), black peppercorns, and coconut.

famousCuisine.name: Crispy Ghee Roast Dosa with Sambar
famousCuisine.desc: Golden paper-thin fermented crepe cooked in pure ghee paired with drumstick sambar and coconut chutneys.

famousCuisine.name: Filter Kaapi & Jigarthanda
famousCuisine.desc: Frothy degree chicory filter coffee served in brass davarah alongside Madurai's famous cooling almond gum dessert.

attractions.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
attractions.desc: Vast temple city with 14 soaring gopurams encrusted with thousands of painted mythological figures.

attractions.name: Shore Temple & Pancha Rathas
attractions.desc: 7th-century coastal rock-cut temples standing resilient against the crashing Bay of Bengal waves.

attractions.name: Nilgiri Mountain Railway
attractions.desc: Charming meter-gauge toy train winding through 208 curves, 16 tunnels, and fragrant eucalyptus slopes.

attractions.name: Dhanushkodi Ghost Town
attractions.desc: Spectacular sandspit where the Indian Ocean meets the Bay of Bengal, steeped in Ramayana lore.

states.travelTips: Dress code rules strictly mandate modest attire (no shorts or sleeveless tops) inside historic temples like Meenakshi Amman.

states.name: Andhra Pradesh
states.tagline: Tirupati Balaji Abode, Araku Coffee Valleys & Kalamkari Art
states.description: Home to the revered hill shrine of Tirumala Venkateswara, the breathtaking Araku Valley, Borra Caves, and the serene beaches of Visakhapatnam.
culturalHighlights: Kalamkari hand-painted organic cotton textiles of Srikalahasti
Classical Kuchipudi dance originating in Krishna district
Lepakshi architectural wonder and hanging pillar
Kondapalli handcrafted soft-wood painted toys

famousCuisine.name: Pulihora & Gongura Pachadi
famousCuisine.desc: Tangy tamarind rice tempered with mustard, curry leaves, and crunchy peanuts served with fiery sorrel leaf pickle.

famousCuisine.name: Andhra Royyala Vepudu
famousCuisine.desc: Crispy prawn fry tossed with shallots, crushed peppercorns, and freshly ground coastal spices.

famousCuisine.name: Pootharekulu & Bobbatlu
famousCuisine.desc: Paper-thin rice starch sweet sheets layered with ghee and powdered jaggery, and lentil-stuffed sweet flatbreads.

attractions.name: Tirumala Venkateswara Temple
attractions.desc: Opulent Dravidian gold-plated temple atop seven holy Seshachalam hills, welcoming millions of pilgrims.

attractions.name: Araku Valley & Borra Caves
attractions.desc: Million-year-old limestone stalactite caves surrounded by cloud-kissed organic coffee plantations.

attractions.name: Lepakshi Veerabhadra Temple
attractions.desc: Exquisite 16th-century stone temple famous for its mysterious hanging pillar and colossal monolithic Nandi bull.

attractions.name: Rushikonda Beach & Submarine Museum
attractions.desc: Golden sand beach with water sports and India's only decommissioned submarine museum (INS Kursura).

states.travelTips: Book Tirupati special entry darshan tickets online 2-3 months in advance. Sip freshly brewed Araku arabica coffee at tribal stalls.

states.name: Arunachal Pradesh
states.tagline: The Land of the Dawn-Lit Mountains & Tawang Monastery
states.description: India's easternmost frontier where the sun first rises, featuring Tawang Monastery, Sela Pass, and the pristine wilderness of Namdapha National Park.
culturalHighlights: Tawang Monastery - India's largest and world's second-largest Buddhist monastery
Monpa tribal wood carving and colorful Thangka tapestry weaving
Ziro Valley Apatani tribal sustainable agriculture and tattoo heritage
Losar and Torgya Tibetan Buddhist monastic masked dance festivals

famousCuisine.name: Thukpa & Hand-Folded Momos
famousCuisine.desc: Comforting noodle soup with mountain herbs, ginger broth, and steamed dumplings with fiery chili dip.

famousCuisine.name: Bamboo Shoot Pika Pila
famousCuisine.desc: Traditional aromatic condiment prepared from fermented bamboo shoots, king chilies, and pork fat.

famousCuisine.name: Lukter
famousCuisine.desc: Roasted dried meat tossed with flakes of fiery Bhut Jolokia (ghost pepper) and wild herbs.

attractions.name: Tawang Monastery & Sela Pass
attractions.desc: 400-year-old Gelugpa monastery at 10,000 ft overlooking deep Himalayan valleys near frozen Sela Lake.

attractions.name: Ziro Valley
attractions.desc: Emerald pine groves, terraced fish-paddy agro systems, and serene Apatani tribal hamlets.

attractions.name: Namdapha National Park
attractions.desc: Dense sub-tropical rainforest harboring tigers, leopards, snow leopards, and clouded leopards.

attractions.name: Madhuri Lake (Shonga-tser)
attractions.desc: Surreal earthquake-formed lake where dead tree trunks rise out of crystalline turquoise waters.

states.travelTips: Inner Line Permit (ILP) is mandatory for domestic travelers; Protected Area Permit (PAP) for international visitors. Carry sturdy mountain gear.

states.name: Assam
states.tagline: The Realm of the Great One-Horned Rhino & World's Finest Tea
states.description: Famed for Kaziranga and Manas national parks, the mighty Brahmaputra river, Majuli river island, and golden Muga silk.
culturalHighlights: Kaziranga - home to two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses
Rongali Bihu harvest festival celebrated with energetic dhol beats and pepa horn
Muga silk (golden silk) weaving exclusive to the craft village of Sualkuchi
Majuli - world's largest inhabited river island with centuries-old Vaishnavite Satras

famousCuisine.name: Khaar
famousCuisine.desc: Traditional alkaline preparation made with raw papaya, pulses, and sun-dried banana peel ash.

famousCuisine.name: Masor Tenga
famousCuisine.desc: Light and refreshing sour freshwater fish curry stewed with elephant apple or fresh vine tomatoes.

famousCuisine.name: Pitha & Jolpan
famousCuisine.desc: Sticky rice cakes stuffed with grated coconut and liquid date-palm jaggery served with thick curd.

attractions.name: Kaziranga National Park
attractions.desc: Elephant and open jeep safaris traversing tall elephant grass to spot great one-horned rhinos.

attractions.name: Majuli Island
attractions.desc: Monastic Neo-Vaishnavite culture, traditional bamboo mask-making, and riverbank pottery.

attractions.name: Kamakhya Temple
attractions.desc: Ancient hilltop tantric shrine atop Nilachal Hill overlooking the mighty Brahmaputra river.

attractions.name: Heritage Tea Estates of Jorhat
attractions.desc: Colonial planter bungalows amidst velvet green tea estates offering tea tasting sessions.

states.travelTips: Kaziranga safaris are operational from October to April. Take a Brahmaputra sunset river cruise in Guwahati.

states.name: Bihar
states.tagline: The Cradle of Buddhism & Ancient Nalanda University
states.description: Where Gautama Buddha attained enlightenment beneath the Bodhi Tree in Bodh Gaya, and ancient scholars gathered at Nalanda.
culturalHighlights: Bodh Gaya - the sacred site where Gautama Buddha attained Enlightenment under the Bodhi Tree
Ancient Nalanda University - world's earliest residential international university
Madhubani folk painting tradition depicting mythological tales and nature motifs
Chhath Puja - ancient Vedic river sun-worship celebration

famousCuisine.name: Litti Chokha
famousCuisine.desc: Baked whole-wheat dough balls filled with spiced roasted gram flour (sattu), served with charred eggplant mash and desi ghee.

famousCuisine.name: Sattu Sharbat
famousCuisine.desc: Nutritious and cooling roasted gram flour beverage flavored with cumin, mint, and black salt.

famousCuisine.name: Khaja & Thekua
famousCuisine.desc: Multi-layered flaky pastry dipped in clear sugar syrup alongside festive whole-wheat jaggery cookies.

attractions.name: Mahabodhi Temple & Bodhi Tree
attractions.desc: 50-meter pyramidical brick temple housing the sacred Diamond Throne where the Buddha meditated.

attractions.name: Ruins of Nalanda University
attractions.desc: Vast 5th-century CE red-brick ruins of lecture halls, meditation cells, and stupas.

attractions.name: Rajgir Ropeway & Peace Pagoda
attractions.desc: Scenic aerial chairlift climbing Ratnagiri Hill to a gleaming white Japanese Peace Pagoda.

attractions.name: Barabar Caves
attractions.desc: Oldest surviving rock-cut caves in India dating back to the Mauryan Empire (322-185 BCE) with mirror-polished granite interiors.

states.travelTips: Winter (November to February) offers crisp, cool weather for exploring the Buddhist circuit. Hire licensed ASI guides at Nalanda.

states.name: Chhattisgarh
states.tagline: India's Niagara at Chitrakote & Tribal Heritage Bastar
states.description: Dense sal forests, Chitrakote horseshoe falls on the Indravati river, and Bastar bell metal craft traditions.
culturalHighlights: Bastar tribal bell-metal craft (Dhokra) and terracotta votive sculptures
Chitrakote Falls - celebrated as the 'Niagara of India' on the Indravati River
Bastar Dussehra - unique 75-day festival worshipping Goddess Danteshwari
Kanger Valley underground limestone caves and natural stalagmites

famousCuisine.name: Chila & Farra
famousCuisine.desc: Steamed rice flour rolls tempered with green chilies, sesame seeds, and mustard seeds.

famousCuisine.name: Bafauri
famousCuisine.desc: Nutritious steamed chana dal dumplings infused with minced garlic and coriander leaves.

famousCuisine.name: Dubki Kadhi
famousCuisine.desc: Tender moong dal dumplings simmered in tangy spiced yogurt curry.

attractions.name: Chitrakote Falls
attractions.desc: Massive horseshoe waterfall plunging nearly 100 feet amidst lush Sal and Teak forests.

attractions.name: Kanger Valley & Kutumsar Cave
attractions.desc: Subterranean limestone cavern with stalagmites, stalactites, and blind cave-dwelling fish.

attractions.name: Sirpur Monuments
attractions.desc: 7th-century brick-built Laxman Temple and ancient Buddhist viharas.

attractions.name: Tirathgarh Waterfalls
attractions.desc: White foaming multi-tier waterfall cascading over split rock boulders.

states.travelTips: Engage a registered tribal guide in Jagdalpur for authentic village visits and weekly haats (tribal bazaars).

states.name: Gujarat
states.tagline: White Rann of Kutch, Asiatic Lions & Vibrant Garba
states.description: Vast white salt desert illuminated under the full moon during Rann Utsav, Gir National Park lions, and Mahatma Gandhi's Sabarmati Ashram.
culturalHighlights: Great Rann of Kutch white salt desert and vibrant Rann Utsav carnival
Statue of Unity - world's tallest monument standing 182 meters tall
Gir National Park - sole surviving natural haven of Asiatic Lions
Double-ikat Patola silk weaving, Rogan painting, and Bandhani tie-dye

famousCuisine.name: Gujarati Thali
famousCuisine.desc: Lavish vegetarian platter featuring sweet-and-sour Gujarati dal, ringna no oro, rotla, kadi, and farsan.

famousCuisine.name: Dhokla & Khandvi
famousCuisine.desc: Spongy steamed fermented gram flour cakes and delicate tightly rolled seasoned chickpea sheets.

famousCuisine.name: Dabeli & Fafda Jalebi
famousCuisine.desc: Spicy potato buns stuffed with pomegranate seeds and peanuts, paired with crisp gram-flour strips and sweet jalebis.

attractions.name: White Rann of Kutch
attractions.desc: Vast expanse of white salt desert glistening under moonlight during the annual Rann Utsav.

attractions.name: Statue of Unity
attractions.desc: 182-meter monumental tribute to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel with high-speed viewing gallery overlooking Narmada dam.

attractions.name: Gir National Park
attractions.desc: Rugged deciduous teak forests offering jeep safaris to witness wild Asiatic lions in their native territory.

attractions.name: Somnath & Dwarkadhish Temples
attractions.desc: First of the 12 holy Shiva Jyotirlingas directly on the Arabian Sea shore, alongside Lord Krishna's sacred capital.

states.travelTips: Book Gir safari permits 60 days ahead online. Full moon nights during Rann Utsav (November-February) offer unforgettable desert views.

states.name: Haryana
states.tagline: Epic Battlefield of Kurukshetra & Surajkund Crafts
states.description: Historic sites of the Mahabharata, Sultanpur bird sanctuary, and the vibrant Surajkund International Crafts Mela.
culturalHighlights: Kurukshetra - sacred battlefield of the Mahabharata and birthplace of the Bhagavad Gita
Surajkund International Crafts Mela showcasing rural master craftsmen
Pinjore Mughal Gardens (Yadavindra Gardens) terraced fountains
Vibrant rural agrarian heritage, folk Raginis, and traditional Akhadas

famousCuisine.name: Bajra Khichdi with Makkhan
famousCuisine.desc: Slow-cooked pearl millet and moong dal porridge generously crowned with homemade white butter.

famousCuisine.name: Hara Dhania Choliya
famousCuisine.desc: Tender green chickpeas simmered in aromatic fresh coriander, onion, and tomato curry.

famousCuisine.name: Singri Ki Sabzi & Malpua
famousCuisine.desc: Sun-dried desert bean curry accompanied by warm, cardamom-infused sweet pancakes.

attractions.name: Brahma Sarovar & Jyotisar
attractions.desc: Colossal sacred water body and the holy banyan tree marking where Lord Krishna delivered the Bhagavad Gita.

attractions.name: Yadavindra Gardens (Pinjore)
attractions.desc: Seven-tiered Mughal terraced pleasure garden with illuminated fountains and Shish Mahal pavilion.

attractions.name: Sultanpur National Park
attractions.desc: Lush wetland hosting over 250 species of resident and winter migratory birds including Siberian cranes.

attractions.name: Surajkund Ancient Amphitheatre
attractions.desc: Semicircular stepped stone amphitheater and water reservoir host to the world's largest crafts mela in February.

states.travelTips: Visit Surajkund in February to witness artists and performers from over 20 nations and every Indian state.

states.name: Jharkhand
states.tagline: The Land of Forests, Roaring Waterfalls & Betla Wildlife
states.description: Famous for scenic waterfalls like Hundru and Dassam, Parasnath Jain temples, and lush tribal homelands.
culturalHighlights: Betla National Park & Palamu Fort ruins amidst dense sal jungles
Sohrai and Khovar indigenous tribal mural and wall art traditions
Baidyanath Dham at Deoghar - one of the 12 sacred Shiva Jyotirlingas
Hundru, Dassam and Jonha rocky waterfalls

famousCuisine.name: Dhuska with Ghugni
famousCuisine.desc: Deep-fried fluffy spiced rice and chana dal bread served with fiery black chickpea and potato curry.

famousCuisine.name: Rugra & Pittha
famousCuisine.desc: Rare wild tribal forest mushrooms cooked with mustard oil and spices, served with steamed rice dumplings.

famousCuisine.name: Arsa Roti
famousCuisine.desc: Traditional sweet pancake prepared from soaked rice flour and jaggery, fried with sesame seeds.

attractions.name: Baidyanath Dham
attractions.desc: Ancient temple complex where millions of devotees carry holy Ganga water during the Shravan Mela.

attractions.name: Hundru & Dassam Falls
attractions.desc: Cascading 320-foot waterfall dropping over crystalline rocks surrounded by lush deciduous forests.

attractions.name: Betla National Park
attractions.desc: Sal forests harboring elephants, tigers, and the historic 16th-century stone forts of the Chero kings.

attractions.name: Parasnath Hill (Shikharji)
attractions.desc: 4,480 ft high holy pilgrimage mountain where 20 of the 24 Jain Tirthankaras attained Nirvana.

states.travelTips: October to March is the best window for exploring waterfalls around Ranchi. Purchase authentic Sohrai tribal paintings directly from artisans in Hazaribagh.

states.name: Karnataka
states.tagline: The Boulders of Hampi, Coorg Coffee & Royal Mysore
states.description: UNESCO Vijayanagara ruins at Hampi, illuminated Mysore Palace during Dasara, coffee mist in Coorg, and Gokarna beaches.
culturalHighlights: Hampi - UNESCO World Heritage ruins of the glorious 14th-century Vijayanagara Empire
Mysore Palace illuminated with 100,000 bulbs during Dasara festivities
Coorg (Kodagu) misty coffee plantations, cardamom hills, and Kodava culture
Classical Yakshagana folk dance-theatre and Carnatic musical tradition

famousCuisine.name: Bisi Bele Bath & Mysore Masala Dosa
famousCuisine.desc: Hearty rice, lentil, and vegetable stew, paired with crisp golden dosa smeared with red chili-garlic paste.

famousCuisine.name: Coorg Pandi Curry
famousCuisine.desc: Succulent pork cooked in wild black vinegar (kachampuli) and freshly roasted peppercorns.

famousCuisine.name: Mysore Pak & Filter Kaapi
famousCuisine.desc: Melt-in-mouth gram flour and ghee sweet accompanied by authentic frothy chicory filter coffee.

attractions.name: Hampi Monumental Ruins
attractions.desc: Boulder-strewn surreal landscape housing the Stone Chariot, musical pillars of Vittala Temple, and Virupaksha.

attractions.name: Mysore Palace & Chamundi Hill
attractions.desc: Grand royal palace of the Wadiyars with stained glass ceilings, jewel-encrusted golden thrones, and illuminated courtyards.

attractions.name: Coorg Coffee Plantations & Abbey Falls
attractions.desc: Misty highlands covered in coffee estates, spice trails, and roaring cascades.

attractions.name: Badami Caves & Pattadakal
attractions.desc: 6th-century red sandstone rock-cut shrines overlooking the tranquil waters of Agastya Lake.

states.travelTips: Explore Hampi on rented bicycles or e-scooters in the early morning. Mysore Dasara in autumn features royal elephant processions.

states.name: Madhya Pradesh
states.tagline: The Tiger State & Khajuraho's Sculpted Marvels
states.description: Bandhavgarh and Kanha tiger safaris, Khajuraho erotic temples, Sanchi Buddhist stupa, and Gwalior fort.
culturalHighlights: Khajuraho temples with world-renowned UNESCO stone sculptures
Tiger Capital of India - Bandhavgarh, Kanha, Pench, and Panna national parks
Sanchi Stupa - oldest stone monument in India commissioned by Emperor Ashoka
Gwalior Fort and Ujjain Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga on the Shipra River

famousCuisine.name: Poha Jalebi & Bhutte Ka Kees
famousCuisine.desc: Light flattened rice garnished with sev and pomegranate, paired with hot jalebis and spiced grated corn.

famousCuisine.name: Dal Bafla
famousCuisine.desc: Boiled and baked dough balls soaked in desi ghee, served with spicy tuar dal and raw mango chutney.

famousCuisine.name: Bhopali Gosht Korma
famousCuisine.desc: Slow-cooked Nawabi mutton curry simmered with whole spices, yogurt, and aromatic rose water.

attractions.name: Khajuraho Group of Monuments
attractions.desc: Masterpieces of medieval temple architecture with intricate stone carvings celebrating human vitality.

attractions.name: Bandhavgarh & Kanha National Parks
attractions.desc: Dense Sal forests that inspired Rudyard Kipling's The Jungle Book, home to the highest density of Royal Bengal Tigers.

attractions.name: Great Stupa at Sanchi
attractions.desc: 3rd-century BCE hemispherical stone dome with four intricately carved ornamental Torana gateways.

attractions.name: Gwalior Fort & Man Mandir
attractions.desc: Perched 300 feet on an isolated sandstone hill with vibrant blue ceramic tiles and majestic palatial courtyards.

states.travelTips: Book national park safaris 90-120 days in advance via the MP Forest portal. Attend the Khajuraho Dance Festival in February.

states.name: Maharashtra
states.tagline: Gateway of India, Ajanta-Ellora Caves & Sahyadri Treks
states.description: Mumbai's colonial Art Deco and Bollywood glamour, rock-cut Ajanta and Ellora caves, and misty monsoon Western Ghats.
culturalHighlights: Ajanta & Ellora Caves - magnificent rock-cut Buddhist, Hindu, and Jain cave temples
Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj sea forts and Sahyadri mountain citadels
Ganesh Chaturthi - grand community festival with energetic dhol-tasha processions
Lavani classical folk dance and handwoven Paithani silk sarees

famousCuisine.name: Vada Pav & Pav Bhaji
famousCuisine.desc: Mumbai's beloved street snack of spiced potato fritter in buttered bread, alongside mashed vegetable curry with hot pav.

famousCuisine.name: Misal Pav
famousCuisine.desc: Fiery sprouted moth bean curry garnished with farsan, chopped onions, and lemon wedges.

famousCuisine.name: Puran Poli & Pithla Bhakri
famousCuisine.desc: Cardamom and jaggery-infused sweet flatbreads, and rustic spiced gram-flour curry with hot jowar flatbread.

attractions.name: Gateway of India & Marine Drive
attractions.desc: Iconic basalt arch on the Arabian Sea waterfront and Queen's Necklace promenade glowing at sunset.

attractions.name: Ajanta & Ellora Caves
attractions.desc: Kailasa Temple - world's largest monolithic rock-cut structure carved top-down from a single cliff face.

attractions.name: Lonavala, Khandala & Mahabaleshwar
attractions.desc: Misty mountain peaks, deep green gorges, monsoon waterfalls, and fresh strawberry orchards.

attractions.name: Shirdi Sai Baba Temple
attractions.desc: Spiritual sanctuary welcoming millions of devotees of all faiths from around the world.

states.travelTips: Mumbai's local trains have intense rush hours (8-11am & 5-8pm); opt for Metro or taxis then. Visit Western Ghats during monsoon (July-September) for vibrant waterfalls.

states.name: Manipur
states.tagline: Floating Phumdis of Loktak Lake & Sangai Deer
states.description: World's only floating national park on Loktak Lake, Kangla Fort, and graceful classical Manipuri Raas Leela dance.
culturalHighlights: Loktak Lake - world's only floating lake with circular natural biomass islands (phumdis)
Classical Manipuri Raas Leela dance with graceful bell-shaped Kumil skirts
Ima Keithel (Mother's Market) - world's largest 500-year-old all-women operated bazaar
Sangai deer - the endangered dancing brow-antlered deer found only in Manipur

famousCuisine.name: Kangshoi
famousCuisine.desc: Nutritious seasonal vegetable stew simmered with fermented fish (ngari), ginger, and fresh green chilies.

famousCuisine.name: Singju
famousCuisine.desc: Fiery spicy cabbage and seasonal greens salad tossed with roasted sesame, perilla seeds, and chili paste.

famousCuisine.name: Chak-hao Kheer
famousCuisine.desc: Delicate royal purple pudding made with aromatic indigenous black rice, rich milk, and dry fruits.

attractions.name: Loktak Lake & Keibul Lamjao
attractions.desc: World's only floating wildlife sanctuary where the endangered Sangai deer dances on floating vegetation.

attractions.name: Ima Keithel (Mother's Market)
attractions.desc: Historic marketplace entirely managed by over 5,000 women selling handlooms, produce, and traditional brassware.

attractions.name: Kangla Fort
attractions.desc: Historic citadel of the Meitei kingdom with sacred ponds, royal shrines, and dragon statues (Kangla Sha).

attractions.name: Dzukou Valley Trailhead
attractions.desc: Dramatic undulating green hills, crystal-clear streams, and rare seasonal Dzukou lilies.

states.travelTips: Visit in late November for the vibrant Manipur Sangai Festival celebrating local art, handloom, and polo.

states.name: Mizoram
states.tagline: Rolling Blue Hills, Cheraw Bamboo Dance & Pristine Mist
states.description: Known as the Land of Blue Mountains (Phawngpui), featuring bamboo dance festivals and hilltop church architecture.
culturalHighlights: Cheraw (Bamboo Dance) performed with rapid rhythmic clicking bamboo poles
Chapchar Kut - joyous spring harvest festival celebrated with folk songs and feasts
Phawngpui (Blue Mountain) - sacred peak rich in orchids and rhododendrons
Reiek Tlang scenic cliff ridge and preserved traditional Mizo village

famousCuisine.name: Bai
famousCuisine.desc: Nutritious boiled vegetable or pork stew prepared with bamboo shoots, mustard leaves, and local soda.

famousCuisine.name: Vawksa Rep
famousCuisine.desc: Fragrant smoked pork stir-fried with mustard greens, garlic, and fiery bird's eye chilies.

famousCuisine.name: Sanpiau
famousCuisine.desc: Comforting rice porridge topped with crushed black pepper, fresh coriander, and crispy pork cracklings.

attractions.name: Phawngpui (Blue Mountain)
attractions.desc: 7,000 ft high mountain peak offering views of Myanmar, bamboo groves, and endangered clouded leopards.

attractions.name: Reiek Peak & Heritage Village
attractions.desc: Sheer rock precipice with views stretching to the plains of Bangladesh, beside a preserved Mizo model village.

attractions.name: Vantawng Falls
attractions.desc: Two-tiered 750-foot waterfall cascading through dense bamboo and teak forests.

attractions.name: Solomon's Temple
attractions.desc: Gleaming white marble cathedral set amidst manicured pine gardens on the outskirts of Aizawl.

states.travelTips: Domestic visitors require an Inner Line Permit (ILP), obtainable at Lengpui Airport or online. Sundays are observed as quiet sabbath days across towns.

states.name: Nagaland
states.tagline: The Hornbill Festival & Emerald Dzukou Valley
states.description: Famous for the Hornbill Festival celebrating 16 indigenous tribes, Dzukou Valley bamboo treks, and scenic Naga hills.
culturalHighlights: Hornbill Festival - the celebrated 'Festival of Festivals' held at Kisama Heritage Village
16 distinct indigenous tribes each with unique colorful woven shawls and warrior folklore
Dzukou Valley trek between Nagaland and Manipur
Khonoma - Asia's first certified community-led green conservation village

famousCuisine.name: Smoked Pork with Axone (Akhuni)
famousCuisine.desc: Tender wood-smoked pork cooked with fermented soybean paste and fiery Raja Mircha chilies.

famousCuisine.name: Anishi Pork Curry
famousCuisine.desc: Rich pork curry prepared with fermented and smoke-dried taro yam patties.

famousCuisine.name: Galho
famousCuisine.desc: Wholesome Naga khichdi made of local rice, tender vegetables, fresh bamboo shoots, and smoked meat.

attractions.name: Kisama Heritage Village
attractions.desc: Permanent tribal cultural village featuring traditional Morungs (dormitories), ceremonial log drums, and totems.

attractions.name: Dzukou Valley
attractions.desc: Rolling emerald green dwarf-bamboo hills dissected by crystal meandering streams at 8,000 ft.

attractions.name: Khonoma Green Village
attractions.desc: 700-year-old Angami village renowned for community ban on logging and hillside terraced farming.

attractions.name: Kohima War Cemetery
attractions.desc: Immaculately maintained memorial on Garrison Hill overlooking the famous Battle of the Tennis Court.

states.travelTips: Book Kohima stays 4-6 months in advance for the Hornbill Festival (December 1-10). Inner Line Permit (ILP) required.

states.name: Odisha
states.tagline: Konark Sun Temple, Puri Jagannath Rath & Chilika Lake
states.description: Chariot architecture at Konark Sun Temple, sacred Rath Yatra in Puri, and dolphin boat cruises in Asia's largest brackish lagoon Chilika.
culturalHighlights: Konark Sun Temple - 13th-century stone chariot masterpiece and UNESCO World Heritage site
Jagannath Temple Puri and the grand annual Rath Yatra (Chariot Festival)
Odissi classical dance and intricate Pattachitra palm-leaf paintings of Raghurajpur
Chilika Lake - Asia's largest brackish lagoon with playful Irrawaddy dolphins

famousCuisine.name: Dalma & Pakhala Bhata
famousCuisine.desc: Nutritious lentil stew with raw papaya, pumpkin, and roasted spices, alongside fermented cooling curd rice.

famousCuisine.name: Chhena Poda
famousCuisine.desc: Odisha's signature caramelized roasted cottage cheese dessert with cardamom and crunchy cashew crust.

famousCuisine.name: Crab Kassa & Machha Besara
famousCuisine.desc: Fiery spicy mud crab masala and freshwater fish cooked in pungent yellow mustard paste.

attractions.name: Konark Sun Temple
attractions.desc: Gigantic stone chariot with 24 carved sundial wheels pulled by 7 stone horses, aligned to the sunrise.

attractions.name: Jagannath Temple & Golden Beach
attractions.desc: 12th-century holy shrine hosting the world-famous Chariot Festival, beside a pristine Blue Flag beach.

attractions.name: Chilika Lake & Satapada
attractions.desc: Vast wetland lagoon hosting migratory Siberian birds and boat safaris to spot endangered Irrawaddy dolphins.

attractions.name: Udayagiri & Khandagiri Caves
attractions.desc: 2nd-century BCE rock-cut monastic caves carved under King Kharavela featuring the famous Hathigumpha inscription.

states.travelTips: Visit the artisan village of Raghurajpur near Puri to watch Pattachitra painters at work. Taste warm Chhena Poda directly from local confectioners.

states.name: Punjab
states.tagline: The Golden Temple of Amritsar, Bhangra & Hearty Hospitality
states.description: The radiant Golden Temple (Sri Harmandir Sahib) serving free langar to 100,000 pilgrims daily, Wagah Border retreat ceremony, and yellow mustard fields.
culturalHighlights: Sri Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple) in Amritsar feeding over 100,000 pilgrims daily in free Langar
Wagah Border Beating Retreat ceremony between India and Pakistan
High-energy Bhangra and Giddha folk dance accompanied by the dhol drum
Phulkari floral geometric embroidery and handcrafted Punjabi Juttis

famousCuisine.name: Makki di Roti & Sarson da Saag
famousCuisine.desc: Slow-cooked winter mustard greens topped with rich white butter, served with hot cornmeal flatbread and jaggery.

famousCuisine.name: Amritsari Kulcha with Chole
famousCuisine.desc: Flaky, crisp tandoor-baked flatbread stuffed with spiced potatoes and onions, served with tangy chickpea curry.

famousCuisine.name: Punjabi Lassi & Butter Chicken
famousCuisine.desc: Thick sweet churned yogurt topped with clotted cream (malai), and tandoori chicken simmered in rich buttery tomato sauce.

attractions.name: Golden Temple (Sri Harmandir Sahib)
attractions.desc: Gleaming gold-leaf sanctum surrounded by the sacred Amrit Sarovar pool, open 24/7 to all humankind.

attractions.name: Wagah Border
attractions.desc: High-octane evening military flag-lowering drill with synchronized goose-stepping guards and patriotic crowds.

attractions.name: Jallianwala Bagh Memorial
attractions.desc: Historic memorial preserving the Martyr's Well and bullet marks honoring the 1919 freedom fighters.

attractions.name: Virasat-e-Khalsa
attractions.desc: Architectural masterpiece designed by Moshe Safdie tracing 500 years of Sikh history and philosophy.

states.travelTips: Cover your head and remove footwear before entering any Gurudwara. Participate in the Langar (community kitchen) volunteer seva.

states.name: Sikkim
states.tagline: Kangchenjunga Guardian, Organic Wonderland & High Passes
states.bestMonths: March to May & Oct to Dec
states.description: India's first fully organic state beneath the third-highest mountain Kangchenjunga, featuring Nathu La pass and Gurudongmar Lake.
culturalHighlights: Kangchenjunga - world's 3rd highest peak revered as a sacred guardian deity
Rumtek and Pemayangtse ancient Tibetan Buddhist monasteries
India's first 100% certified organic agricultural state promoting clean eco-tourism
Tsomgo Lake and Nathu La mountain pass on the historic Old Silk Route

famousCuisine.name: Authentic Steamed Momos & Thukpa
famousCuisine.desc: Thin-skinned dumplings packed with mountain vegetables or meat, accompanied by spicy Dalle Khursani chili sauce.

famousCuisine.name: Gundruk & Sinki Soup
famousCuisine.desc: Traditional fermented leafy mustard and radish taproot broth with ginger and garlic.

famousCuisine.name: Sel Roti & Chhurpi Stew
famousCuisine.desc: Ring-shaped crispy sweet rice bread served with traditional hardened yak cheese soup.

attractions.name: Tsomgo Lake & Nathu La Pass
attractions.desc: Glacial lake at 12,310 ft changing colors with seasons, and the historic Indo-China Silk Route pass.

attractions.name: Rumtek Monastery
attractions.desc: Grand Tibetan Buddhist monastery with golden stupa, intricate wall murals, and chanting monks.

attractions.name: Gurudongmar Lake
attractions.desc: One of the highest lakes in the world at 17,800 ft, holy to Buddhists, Sikhs, and Hindus.

attractions.name: Yuksom & Kangchenjunga Trail
attractions.desc: Historic coronation throne of the Chogyal kings and starting point for high Himalayan expeditions.

states.travelTips: Nathu La Pass and North Sikkim require special military permits obtained through registered Gangtok operators 24h prior.

states.name: Telangana
states.tagline: Charminar, Golconda Diamonds & World-Famous Biryani
states.description: Hyderabad's historic Charminar, acoustic marvels of Golconda Fort, Ramoji Film City, and iconic Hyderabadi Dum Biryani.
culturalHighlights: Charminar and Golconda Fort - architectural emblems of Qutb Shahi and Asaf Jahi dynasties
Hyderabadi pearl markets and Bidriware silver inlay metalwork
Ramappa Temple - UNESCO World Heritage engineering marvel built with lightweight floating bricks
Bonalu and Bathukamma colorful floral harvest festivals

famousCuisine.name: Hyderabadi Dum Biryani
famousCuisine.desc: Fragrant long-grain basmati rice layered with spiced meat, saffron, and fried onions, slow-cooked in a sealed handi.

famousCuisine.name: Mirchi Ka Salan & Double Ka Meetha
famousCuisine.desc: Spicy peanut, sesame, and chili gravy alongside royal fried bread pudding soaked in saffron rabdi.

famousCuisine.name: Haleem
famousCuisine.desc: Rich, slow-cooked porridge of meat, broken wheat, lentils, and pure desi ghee simmered for 12 hours.

attractions.name: Charminar & Laad Bazaar
attractions.desc: 16th-century grand monument surrounded by bustling bazaars selling natural pearls and lac bangles.

attractions.name: Golconda Fort & Qutb Shahi Tombs
attractions.desc: Massive medieval fortress famous for acoustic clapping signals and origin of the Koh-i-Noor diamond.

attractions.name: Ramappa Temple
attractions.desc: 13th-century Kakatiya temple crafted from sandbox foundation and floating bricks with exquisite basalt dancers.

attractions.name: Salar Jung Museum
attractions.desc: One of the world's greatest one-man antique collections including the veiled marble statue of Rebecca.

states.travelTips: Pair Irani chai with sweet Osmania biscuits at century-old cafes near Charminar. Attend the Golconda Fort sound and light show at dusk.

states.name: Tripura
states.tagline: Ujjayanta Palace, Neermahal Water Castle & Unakoti Rock Carvings
states.description: Neermahal palace surrounded by Rudrasagar Lake and the colossal bas-relief stone carvings of Lord Shiva at Unakoti.
culturalHighlights: Ujjayanta Palace and Neermahal - eastern India's only royal lake water palace
Unakoti rock-cut colossal bas-relief stone sculptures of Lord Shiva
Intricate indigenous cane, bamboo handicrafts, and handwoven Pachra textiles
Tripura Sundari Temple - ancient 500-year-old sacred Shakti Peeth

famousCuisine.name: Mui Borok & Berma
famousCuisine.desc: Traditional fermented fish preparation slow-cooked with fresh river fish, seasonal greens, and green chilies.

famousCuisine.name: Chakhwi
famousCuisine.desc: Pork and bamboo shoot curry prepared with ginger, baking soda, and local fresh herbs.

famousCuisine.name: Wahan Mosdeng
famousCuisine.desc: Charcoal-roasted shredded pork mixed with charred onions, fresh coriander, and fiery green chilies.

attractions.name: Neermahal Lake Palace
attractions.desc: Gleaming white palace built in 1930 floating in the center of the Rudrasagar Lake.

attractions.name: Unakoti Rock Sculptures
attractions.desc: 7th-9th century colossal rock carving of Shiva's head rising 30 feet out of dense jungle hills.

attractions.name: Ujjayanta Palace
attractions.desc: Neoclassical white palace set within formal Mughal gardens, now housing Northeast India's premier museum.

attractions.name: Tripura Sundari Temple
attractions.desc: 500-year-old pilgrimage shrine shaped like a tortoise, situated on the banks of Kalyan Sagar.

states.travelTips: Take a scenic rowboat to Neermahal from Rajghat. Wear comfortable shoes to explore the stone stairways of Unakoti.

states.name: Uttarakhand
states.tagline: Yoga Capital Rishikesh, Valley of Flowers & Char Dham
states.bestMonths: March to June & Sep to Nov
states.description: World Capital of Yoga in Rishikesh, UNESCO Valley of Flowers carpeted in alpine blooms, Jim Corbett tigers, and ski slopes of Auli.
culturalHighlights: Devbhoomi (Land of the Gods) - revered Char Dham shrines (Badrinath, Kedarnath, Gangotri, Yamunotri)
Rishikesh - world yoga capital on the sacred banks of the Ganga river
Jim Corbett National Park - India's oldest national park and premier tiger haven
Valley of Flowers UNESCO World Heritage alpine meadow

famousCuisine.name: Kafuli & Chainsoo
famousCuisine.desc: Nutritious thick gravy of spinach and fenugreek leaves, paired with roasted black gram dal simmered in iron pots.

famousCuisine.name: Aloo ke Gutke with Bhang Chutney
famousCuisine.desc: Fried mountain potatoes seasoned with wild jamboo herb and whole red chilies, served with hemp-seed dip.

famousCuisine.name: Bal Mithai & Singori
famousCuisine.desc: Roasted brown fudge coated in white sugar balls, and condensed milk sweets wrapped in fragrant Maalu leaves.

attractions.name: Kedarnath & Badrinath
attractions.desc: Ancient stone temples perched dramatically amidst towering snow-clad peaks.

attractions.name: Rishikesh & Haridwar Ghats
attractions.desc: Soul-stirring evening fire prayers on the holy riverbanks and thrilling whitewater rafting.

attractions.name: Jim Corbett National Park
attractions.desc: Pristine Sal forests along the Ramganga river harboring Royal Bengal tigers, wild elephants, and leopards.

attractions.name: Valley of Flowers & Hemkund
attractions.desc: High alpine meadow carpeted with 500+ species of wild Himalayan blooms at 12,000 ft.

states.travelTips: Char Dham yatra requires mandatory biometric registration online. Valley of Flowers is accessible strictly from July to September.

states.name: West Bengal
states.tagline: Durga Puja Carnivals, Darjeeling Toy Train & Sundarban Mangroves
states.description: The cultural city of Kolkata with Victoria Memorial, Darjeeling tea gardens with Everest views, and Sundarbans Royal Bengal tiger mangroves.
culturalHighlights: Kolkata - Cultural Capital of India with Victoria Memorial, Howrah Bridge, and colonial coffee houses
Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (Toy Train) and aromatic single-estate black teas
Sundarbans - world's largest mangrove delta and home of the swimming Royal Bengal Tiger
Durga Puja - UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage grand community festival

famousCuisine.name: Shorshe Ilish & Kosha Mangsho
famousCuisine.desc: Hilsa fish cooked in pungent yellow mustard and green chili gravy, and slow-cooked rich dark mutton curry.

famousCuisine.name: Kolkata Biryani & Kathi Roll
famousCuisine.desc: Aromatic Awadhi-style basmati rice with spiced potatoes and boiled egg, and flaky parathas wrapped around kebabs.

famousCuisine.name: Rosogolla & Mishti Doi
famousCuisine.desc: Spongy cottage cheese balls soaked in warm syrup alongside caramelized sweetened baked yogurt.

attractions.name: Victoria Memorial & Howrah Bridge
attractions.desc: White Makrana marble monument set in sprawling gardens, beside the iconic cantilever steel bridge across Hooghly.

attractions.name: Darjeeling Tiger Hill & Tea Gardens
attractions.desc: Golden sunrise views over Mt. Kanchenjunga and vintage Toy Train rides winding through misty tea estates.

attractions.name: Sundarbans Mangrove Delta
attractions.desc: Vast tidal mangrove waterways explored via motorboats to spot wild tigers, estuarine crocodiles, and spotted deer.

attractions.name: Dakshineswar & Belur Math
attractions.desc: Historic 19th-century riverside Kali temple and Ramakrishna Mission headquarters symbolizing unity of faiths.

states.travelTips: Ride a vintage yellow Ambassador taxi or Kolkata tram. Book the Darjeeling Toy Train joyride early through IRCTC.

states.name: Andaman & Nicobar Islands
states.tagline: Radhanagar Turquoise Waters, Coral Reefs & Cellular Jail
states.description: Pristine white sand beaches on Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep), scuba diving with sea turtles, and national historic memorial Cellular Jail.
culturalHighlights: Radhanagar Beach - voted among Asia's best beaches by Time magazine
Cellular Jail (Kala Pani) national memorial in Port Blair
Pristine coral reefs of Havelock (Swaraj Dweep) and Neil Island
Scuba diving, bioluminescent night kayaking, and undersea walking

famousCuisine.name: Andaman Fish Curry
famousCuisine.desc: Fresh ocean catch simmered in rich coconut milk, curry leaves, and coastal spices.

famousCuisine.name: Tandoori Lobster & Prawn Butter Garlic
famousCuisine.desc: Freshly grilled local lobster and butter-garlic tossed jumbo prawns served at beachfront shacks.

famousCuisine.name: Coconut Prawn Curry & Banana Halwa
famousCuisine.desc: Creamy seafood curry served with hot rice and sweet local plantain halwa.

attractions.name: Radhanagar Beach
attractions.desc: Powdery white sand fringed by tall mahua trees opening onto calm turquoise waters and sunset views.

attractions.name: Cellular Jail National Memorial
attractions.desc: Seven-winged colonial prison where Indian freedom fighters were exiled, featuring a moving evening sound and light show.

attractions.name: Elephant Beach & Reefs
attractions.desc: Crystal-clear shallow waters teeming with vibrant coral reefs, sea anemones, and colorful clownfish.

attractions.name: Ross Island (NSC Bose Dweep)
attractions.desc: British colonial ruins beautifully overgrown by aerial banyan tree roots, with friendly spotted deer roaming free.

states.travelTips: Book high-speed inter-island private catamaran ferries (Makruzz / Nautika) 3-4 weeks ahead. Strict penalties apply for touching coral reefs.

states.name: Chandigarh
states.tagline: The City Beautiful, Le Corbusier Architecture & Rock Garden
states.description: India's premier planned city, Nek Chand's recycled art Rock Garden, and Sukhna Lake promenades.
culturalHighlights: India's first planned modern city designed by Swiss-French master architect Le Corbusier
Nek Chand's Rock Garden - 20-acre labyrinth made entirely from industrial and urban waste
Sukhna Lake morning walks, boating, and Shivalik mountain vistas
Zakir Hussain Rose Garden - Asia's largest rose conservatory

famousCuisine.name: Chole Bhature
famousCuisine.desc: Puffy golden fried leavened bread served with spiced chickpea gravy, pickled carrots, and green chili.

famousCuisine.name: Stuffed Butter Paranthas
famousCuisine.desc: Crispy tandoori paranthas loaded with paneer or potatoes, crowned with melting homemade white butter.

famousCuisine.name: Rabdi Falooda
famousCuisine.desc: Chilled dessert layered with rose syrup, vermicelli, sweet basil seeds, and rich clotted cream.

attractions.name: Nek Chand's Rock Garden
attractions.desc: Fantasy kingdom of courtyards, waterfalls, and sculptures sculpted from broken bangles, ceramic tiles, and discarded sockets.

attractions.name: Sukhna Lake
attractions.desc: 3 sq km peaceful lake at the base of the Shivalik hills, beloved for paddle boating and jogging.

attractions.name: Capitol Complex & Open Hand
attractions.desc: Le Corbusier's iconic concrete masterpieces including the Secretariat, High Court, and rotating Open Hand Monument.

attractions.name: Zakir Hussain Rose Garden
attractions.desc: 30-acre landscaped park displaying 1,600 varieties of blooming roses and medicinal trees.

states.travelTips: Rent public SmartBikes to explore Chandigarh's dedicated, tree-canopied cycling tracks across sectors.

states.name: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states.tagline: Portuguese Coastal Bastions, Nagoa Beach & Quiet Shres
states.description: Historic seaside forts of Moti Daman and Diu Fort, peaceful palm-fringed coastlines, and colonial chapels.
culturalHighlights: 16th-century Portuguese coastal fortresses, ramparts, and cathedrals in Diu
Silvassa lush tribal landscapes and indigenous Warli wall art
Nagoa Beach crescent lined with rare branching African Hoka trees
Tranquil Arabian Sea coastal promenades and water sports

famousCuisine.name: Cozido & Crab Masala
famousCuisine.desc: Portuguese-influenced slow-cooked meat and vegetable stew alongside spiced fresh sea crab.

famousCuisine.name: Khatta Meetha Poha
famousCuisine.desc: Sweet and tangy tempered flattened rice with roasted peanuts, curry leaves, and lemon juice.

famousCuisine.name: Daman Coastal Seafood Platter
famousCuisine.desc: Fresh pomfret and tiger prawns marinated in Konkani spices and rava fried to a crisp golden crust.

attractions.name: Diu Fort & St. Paul's Church
attractions.desc: Massive stone sea fortress with vintage cannons overlooking crashing waves and a 1601 Baroque cathedral.

attractions.name: Nagoa Beach
attractions.desc: Calm, sheltered horseshoe bay fringed by rare branching Hoka trees brought by Portuguese sailors.

attractions.name: Moti Daman & Nani Daman Forts
attractions.desc: 16th-century bastions housing carved wood altars in the Church of Our Lady of Remedies.

attractions.name: Dudhni Lake & Tribal Museum
attractions.desc: Expansive reservoir offering speedboating, surrounded by tribal cultural artifacts and Warli craft centers.

states.travelTips: Rent a scooter in Diu to explore tranquil lighthouses, sea caves, and beaches at your own relaxed pace.

states.name: Delhi
states.tagline: The Historic Capital, Qutub Minar, Red Fort & Chandni Chowk Food
states.description: Sprawling metropolis housing Humayun's Tomb, India Gate, culinary labyrinth of Old Delhi, and grand Rajpath boulevard.
culturalHighlights: National Capital spanning 8 historic cities of empires over a millennium
UNESCO World Heritage trio: Red Fort, Qutub Minar, and Humayun's Tomb
Chandni Chowk - bustling 350-year-old Mughal bazaar and street food paradise
India Gate, Rashtrapati Bhavan, and sprawling tree-lined Lutyens' boulevards

famousCuisine.name: Butter Chicken & Dal Makhani
famousCuisine.desc: Iconic tandoor-charred chicken in rich tomato-butter-cream gravy and 24-hour slow-cooked black lentils.

famousCuisine.name: Chandni Chowk Paranthe & Chaat
famousCuisine.desc: Crispy fried stuffed flatbreads at Paranthe Wali Gali, and tangy Dahi Bhalla drizzled with tamarind chutney.

famousCuisine.name: Old Delhi Nihari & Khamiri Roti
famousCuisine.desc: Slow-cooked aromatic beef or mutton stew savored early morning near Jama Masjid with soft tandoori bread.

attractions.name: Red Fort (Lal Qila) & Jama Masjid
attractions.desc: 17th-century red sandstone imperial palace of Shah Jahan and India's largest historic congregational mosque.

attractions.name: Qutub Minar & Iron Pillar
attractions.desc: 73m soaring 12th-century victory tower and the 1,600-year-old rust-resistant metallurgical iron pillar.

attractions.name: Humayun's Tomb & Sunder Nursery
attractions.desc: Symmetrical Persian-style red-sandstone and marble mausoleum that inspired the Taj Mahal, beside a 90-acre heritage park.

attractions.name: India Gate & Kartavya Path
attractions.desc: 42-meter ceremonial triumphal arch honoring Indian soldiers, flanked by illuminated fountains and lawns.

states.travelTips: Use the modern Delhi Metro network with a day tourist card to zip across the city seamlessly. Take cycle rickshaws through Old Delhi alleys.

states.name: Jammu & Kashmir
states.tagline: Paradise on Earth, Dal Lake Shikaras & Gulmarg Snow
states.bestMonths: March to October & Dec to Feb
states.description: Gliding on ornate wooden Shikaras in Dal Lake, skiing down powdery Gulmarg slopes, and saffron gardens of Pampore.
culturalHighlights: Srinagar Dal Lake with wooden Shikara gondolas and heritage floating houseboats
Gulmarg - Asia's premier skiing destination with world's highest cable car (Gondola)
Pashmina cashmere wool weaving and walnut wood carving
Mata Vaishno Devi shrine atop Trikuta mountains

famousCuisine.name: Kashmiri Wazwan (Rogan Josh & Rista)
famousCuisine.desc: Multi-course royal feast featuring tender mutton cooked with Kashmiri red chilies, saffron, and velvety yogurt gravy.

famousCuisine.name: Kashmiri Kahwa
famousCuisine.desc: Golden green tea infused with saffron strands, whole cinnamon, green cardamom, and slivered almonds.

famousCuisine.name: Dum Aloo & Nadru Yakhni
famousCuisine.desc: Deep-fried baby potatoes in spicy curd sauce, and crisp lotus stems simmered in delicate aromatic yogurt broth.

attractions.name: Dal Lake & Mughal Gardens
attractions.desc: Tranquil lake dotted with carved cedarwood houseboats, floating flower markets, and terraced Mughal fountains.

attractions.name: Gulmarg Gondola & Apharwat Peak
attractions.desc: Operating cable car reaching 13,780 ft offering panoramic views of Pir Panjal snow peaks and winter skiing.

attractions.name: Pahalgam & Betaab Valley
attractions.desc: Gushing Lidder River, pine-scented mountain trails, pony treks, and gateway to the Amarnath cave.

attractions.name: Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine
attractions.desc: Revered natural holy cave shrine in the Trikuta mountains welcoming over 8 million pilgrims annually.

states.travelTips: Book Gulmarg Gondola Phase 2 tickets 1-2 months ahead online. Stay on a registered heritage houseboat on Nigeen or Dal Lake.

states.name: Lakshadweep
states.tagline: Pristine Coral Atolls, Bangaram Lagoons & Snorkeling Heaven
states.description: Secluded archipelago of 36 islands boasting untouched turquoise lagoons, vibrant coral reefs, and water sports.
culturalHighlights: Pristine coral archipelago in the Arabian Sea with untouched turquoise lagoons
Bangaram, Agatti, and Kavaratti white sand paradise atolls
Rich marine biodiversity: sea turtles, manta rays, and live coral reefs
Traditional coir rope weaving and tuna fishing heritage

famousCuisine.name: Mas Mus & Mus Kavaabu
famousCuisine.desc: Smoked dried skipjack tuna prepared with grated fresh coconut, turmeric, and local herbs.

famousCuisine.name: Octopus Fry & Coconut Fish Curry
famousCuisine.desc: Tender ocean octopus tossed with green chilies, alongside creamy tuna coconut curry.

famousCuisine.name: Rayere Appam
famousCuisine.desc: Fluffy puffed rice dumplings sweetened with palm jaggery and fresh coconut milk.

attractions.name: Bangaram Atoll & Lagoon
attractions.desc: Uninhabited coral island with shallow turquoise lagoon, bioluminescent night plankton, and shipwrecks.

attractions.name: Agatti Island Lagoon
attractions.desc: Spectacular island with an airport runway extending into the sea, surrounded by coral gardens.

attractions.name: Kavaratti Marine Aquarium
attractions.desc: Glass-bottom boat tours, windsurfing, and marine museum showcasing indigenous coral specimens.

attractions.name: Kadmat Island Scuba Diving
attractions.desc: Slender 8km island renowned for crystal clear underwater visibility and live coral reefs.

states.travelTips: Entry Permit is mandatory for all visitors through SPORTS Lakshadweep administration. Alcohol is prohibited except on Bangaram Island.

states.name: Puducherry
states.tagline: French Quarter Bougainvillea, Auroville & Seaside Promenade
states.description: Mustard-yellow French colonial architecture, bicycle-friendly streets, experimental township Auroville, and seaside cafes.
culturalHighlights: French Quarter (White Town) with mustard-yellow colonial villas and bougainvillea
Auroville - international township dedicated to human unity and Matrimandir
Sri Aurobindo Ashram spiritual meditation sanctuary
Promenade Beach and tranquil surfing breaks at Serenity Beach

famousCuisine.name: French-Creole Seafood Bouillabaisse
famousCuisine.desc: Fragrant seafood stew cooked with coastal spices, white wine, and fresh crab, served with baguettes.

famousCuisine.name: Pondicherry Fish Assad
famousCuisine.desc: Delicate white fish curry prepared with fresh coconut milk, aniseed, and mild green chilies.

famousCuisine.name: Buttery Croissants & Cafe Au Lait
famousCuisine.desc: Freshly baked flaky pastries, sourdough sandwiches, and rich French-pressed coffee in charming garden cafes.

attractions.name: White Town (French Quarter)
attractions.desc: Cobblestone streets lined with pastel yellow colonial mansions, chic boutiques, and flowering bougainvillea.

attractions.name: Matrimandir & Auroville
attractions.desc: Golden dome in an international township, featuring an inner white marble silent meditation chamber.

attractions.name: Promenade Beach (Goubert Avenue)
attractions.desc: 1.5 km scenic vehicular-free evening ocean promenade with sea spray and French war memorial.

attractions.name: Paradise Beach & Chunnambar
attractions.desc: Scenic backwater boat ferry ride reaching an isolated spit of golden sand and blue sea.

states.travelTips: Rent a vintage bicycle to explore the French Quarter lanes. Pre-book Matrimandir inner chamber passes 2-3 days prior.

winter.name: Winter (Nov – Feb)
winter.tagline: Crisp Golden Days, Desert Fairs & Snowy Mountain Slopes
winter.climateSummary: Ideal sunny weather across Rajasthan, Central & South India. Heavy snowfall in Kashmir and Himachal.
winter.packingTips: Heavy woolens for Himalayas; light layers and shawls for Rajasthan/Delhi; light cottons for Goa and Kerala.

festivals.name: Pushkar Camel Fair
festivals.desc: World's largest livestock fair with folk music, turban tying competitions, and hot air balloons.

festivals.name: Rann Utsav
festivals.desc: White salt desert carnival with tent cities, Kutchi embroidery stalls, and full-moon camel rides.

festivals.name: Hornbill Festival
festivals.desc: The Festival of Festivals uniting all 16 Naga tribes for indigenous dances, warrior games, and feastings.

festivals.name: Sunburn / Goa Music Festivals
festivals.desc: Vibrant beach parties, Christmas Eve fireworks, and midnight masses in historic Old Goa churches.

summer.name: Summer (Mar – June)
summer.tagline: Cool Alpine Meadows, High Pass Road Trips & Roaring Glacial Rivers
summer.climateSummary: Warm and sunny across the central and southern plains; crisp, pleasant, and accessible in high-altitude Himalayas.
summer.packingTips: Sunscreen, sunglasses, breathable cottons for sightseeing; light fleece jacket for high passes like Khardung La & Rohtang.

festivals.name: Hemis Festival
festivals.desc: Celebration of Guru Padmasambhava with sacred Cham mask dances and huge silk Thangka displays.

festivals.name: Baisakhi
festivals.desc: Harvest festival filled with lively Bhangra, Gidda, and colorful fairs at the Golden Temple.

festivals.name: Ooty Flower Show
festivals.desc: Exhibition of exotic orchids, bonsai, and millions of cut flowers in the Nilgiri Government Botanical Garden.

monsoon.name: Monsoon (July – Sep)
monsoon.tagline: Thunderous Waterfalls, Emerald Terrains & Ayurvedic Rejuvenation
monsoon.climateSummary: Southwest monsoon drenches the subcontinent, turning the Western Ghats and Meghalaya into dramatic rainforests.
monsoon.packingTips: Sturdy waterproof backpack, quick-dry clothes, umbrella, rain poncho, and mosquito repellent.

festivals.name: Onam
festivals.desc: Harvest homecoming of King Mahabali celebrated with floral Pookkalams, Sadya feasts, and snake boat races.

festivals.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
festivals.desc: Grand 10-day celebration in Mumbai with towering Ganesha idols, Dhol-Tasha drumming, and beach immersions.

festivals.name: Teej Festival
festivals.desc: Celebration of monsoon welcoming Parvati with swings hung from banyan trees, Ghevar sweets, and green lehengas.

autumn.name: Autumn (October)
autumn.tagline: Post-Monsoon Clearness, Reopened Tiger Parks & Grand Festivities
autumn.climateSummary: Skies clear up to reveal vibrant blue horizons. Temperatures turn pleasantly mild before winter chill arrives.
autumn.packingTips: Comfortable walking shoes, daylight casuals, light cardigan or stole for cooler evenings.

festivals.name: Durga Puja
festivals.desc: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage: thousands of magnificent themed art pandals, Dhunuchi dance, and festive fervor.

festivals.name: Mysuru Dasara
festivals.desc: Centuries-old royal procession featuring the golden howdah carried by caparisoned elephants and 100,000 bulbs illuminating the Palace.

festivals.name: Diwali (Festival of Lights)
festivals.desc: Millions of clay diyas, fireworks, rangoli patterns, and exchange of sweets celebrating the victory of light over darkness.

backpacker.label: Backpacker / Budget Explorer
backpacker.description: Dorm beds & cozy hostels, authentic street food & dhabas, public transit (metro, sleeper trains & state buses), self-guided exploration.

midrange.label: Comfortable Mid-Range
midrange.description: Private rooms in boutique homestays or 3-star heritage inns, quality local restaurants & cafes, AC trains & private cabs, guided monument tours.

luxury.label: Royal & Luxury Connoisseur
luxury.description: 5-star heritage palaces and premium eco-resorts, fine dining & royal banquets, dedicated private chauffeur vehicles, VIP passes & private wildlife safaris.
